title: MigrationScan
description: Result of scanning native backend configs. Rows marked import are eligible for the server-owned custody-takeover transaction; native material is withdrawn only after staged replacement validation and durable exposure. Blocked native shapes remain visible as keep_native or reauth rows.

masked_detail.description: e.g. 'sk-…dd3c + 自定义 Base URL'; never full secrets

proposed_action.description: import is a supported API-key or complete refresh-capable OAuth takeover. keep_native is a visible, unselected blocker for access-only, unsupported, malformed, or otherwise non-exportable native material; reauth is the explicit invalid-grant/authentication path. controlled_import remains parseable and reserved.

notes_key.description: i18n key for the row's secondary line

vendor.description: Additive presentation metadata (ratified 2026-09-19). The provider this credential belongs to — an OpenCode row carries its native provider id. Optional: a client that does not receive it falls back to masked_detail and a generic icon, and never infers provider identity from `backend`.

display_name.description: Additive presentation metadata. The server's own label for the provider. Not guaranteed friendly — OpenCode currently emits the provider id — so a client maps known vendors to brand names and falls back to this label, then to the slug.

masked_credential.description: Additive presentation metadata. The masked credential alone, produced by the same masking the composed masked_detail used, so a client can render provider and key separately without re-parsing that string. Never a plaintext secret; null on rows that have no credential of their own.

source_paths.description: Additive persisted-file provenance. Locators only, never file contents or environment values. Empty/absent retains the client's generic backend label.

required_backends.description: Backend-group consent closure for a shared persisted assignment. Empty/absent means this row's backend alone. The server independently requires the entire closure.

config_blocker.description: The backend's native config cannot be parsed, so Hub mode would fail every launch. Blocks the row's whole consent group; apply refuses it.

may_hold_api_key.description: Whether applying this row may copy a native API key, including an opaque Codex credential store that resolves only after consent. Clients offer the optional API key cleanup only when a selected row sets it.
